subject: Business Studies
sourceFile: Copy of Business Studies BECE Syllabus - syllabusNG.txt
examFormat: Business Studies covers Office Practice, Commerce, Book-keeping and Keyboarding/Computer, and aims to assess candidates on basic skills for occupations and personal use, knowledge of business studies, the national economy and office occupations, for further training and future employment. The examination has three papers. Paper I: 60 multiple-choice questions in one hour (one mark each) — 30 on Commerce and 30 on Book-keeping. Paper II: 60 multiple-choice questions in one hour — 30 on Keyboarding/Computer and 30 on Office Practice. Paper III: a 20-minute keyboarding practical worth 10 marks — Task 1, five minutes of accuracy and speed (5 marks), and Task 2, 15 minutes of production work (5 marks).
excluded: Left out the syllabus.ng "About Us", "About BECE", eligibility, grading, registration, table of contents and FAQ chapters (publisher marketing / general information, not syllabus content). Themes and sub-themes are recorded in each topic's content rather than as topics.
recommendedTexts: Business Studies for Junior Secondary Schools 1, 2 and 3 — Inanga and Ebun C. Ojo (Spectrum Books)
Business Studies for Junior Secondary Schools 1, 2 and 3 — O. A. Lawal et al. (PTF Low Price, reprinted)
